name: Tesla Bot
tagline: Runs your Tesla from a chat window once the two are paired
description: Pairing happens once, during the opening conversation, and from then on the car answers to plain requests typed into chat. Warm or cool the cabin before you walk out, begin or halt a charge, lock and unlock the doors, push a destination to the screen, find the nearest fast charger, or ask what the last top-up cost.
author: mvanhorn
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
